clean_clone_gate.defect_found_and_fixed: The first clean-clone run failed 4 Godot fixture subtests. Root cause: .godot/ is a gitignored build artifact, so a fresh clone has no import cache and Godot spent its first invocation importing instead of running the fixture. The suite passed locally only because an untracked cache existed. The harness now runs the idempotent import unconditionally and fails loudly with engine output if it errors, rather than trusting the mere existence of .godot/.
